purpose: Teach: 立国/徘徊/潜む/具現/平衡/肥大/抱負/修業

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、技術立国を目指した政策を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote your paper on policies aimed at building a tech-driven nation, didn't you.
lines.style: Gentle, curious prompt. Warm but measured—not leading, inviting confirmation. Eyes steady, slight lean forward showing genuine interest in the answer.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、徘徊する高齢者の見守り体制を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote about the support systems for monitoring elderly people who wander.
lines.style: Clear, direct answer. Young but composed—no hesitation or self-consciousness. Brief pause before speaking, thoughtful delivery of a topic she's considered deeply.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 組織内に潜む差別構造を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You explored the discriminatory structures that hide within organizations, didn't you.
lines.style: Softer observation than a question. Reflective tone, slightly slower pace. A teacher confirming what she's heard, acknowledging the weight of the topic with respect in her voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、理念を具現する企業の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I researched companies that actually embody their stated values and principles.
lines.style: Direct and matter-of-fact. No performative earnestness—just stating what she did. Slight emphasis on 'actually,' showing she knows this is rare and matters.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 医療における平衡感覚の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And your work covered research on balance and spatial awareness in medical contexts, correct.
lines.style: Warm, engaged prompt. Teacher moving through her list with real interest, not routine check-in. Open cadence at the end, inviting her to confirm.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、政治家の権力が肥大する仕組みを論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined how political power grows unchecked—the mechanisms that let it expand.
lines.style: Steady, factual. She's naming something systemic. No anger or breathlessness, but weight behind the words. She understands the topic.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 若い世代の抱負を聞き取った研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your paper also drew on interviews with young people about their hopes and ambitions, yes.
lines.style: Recognition more than question. Appreciative tone, acknowledging the human effort in that research. Slower, thoughtful delivery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、伝統芸能の修業の道のりを論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on the disciplined journey of training in traditional performing arts.
lines.style: Final answer, grounded and complete. Quiet certainty. Slight settling in tone—she's answered fully. Brief, composed, with a sense of closure.
